name: Noto Sans Arabic
summary: Google Fonts specimen page for Noto Sans Arabic, an unmodulated sans-serif for Arabic script with variable weight and width.
description: Specimen page for Noto Sans Arabic on Google Fonts, part of the Noto collection for the world's scripts. An unmodulated sans-serif for Arabic-script text: 1,642 glyphs, 12 OpenType features and 1,161 characters across Arabic and Latin blocks, with 9 weights (100-900) and variable width (62.5-100). Intended for Arabic, Persian, Urdu, Pashto, Kurdish and other right-to-left languages; SIL Open Font License 1.1. The specimen page itself renders with JavaScript, so the facts come from the family's metadata.
